question: For 70 official_pdf_fill families whose named form title matched no filename in the mounted Master Library, is the artifact actually absent - and if not absent, where is it held?
answer: A filename miss was mostly not absence. 46 of the 70 families are fully or partly held already: under a different filename, under a form number instead of a title, at a later revision, inside a combined packet PDF, as a page range in a larger document, in the Nationwide Record Clearing inventory rather than the Master Library, or as a human source return. 16 need a genuine fetch and now carry an established identity. 4 are wrongly modelled as form-based and must be composed from the authority. 1 is not a packet at all. 3 cannot be treated until a named legal question is answered.
method: Every named form was searched by form number, by title words, by issuing agency and by statutory section against: the mounted Master Library corpus, data/rcap-all50/local-source-corpus-index.json (329 indexed PDFs, recorded titles and form numbers), data/rcap-all50/nationwide-source-inventory.json (the committed index of private/Nationwide Record Clearing), data/rcap-grade-a/official-source-registry.json, data/rcap-grade-a/route-obligation-census-v1/source-custody-reconciliation.json, the source-acquisition receipts and URL promotion candidates under data/rcap-grade-a/, the human source returns under data/rcap-grade-a/source-verification/, and the state packs under src/lib/rcap/state-packs/.

Where a candidate was reachable on disk its bytes were read with pdftotext and the printed form number, title and revision were used as the identity evidence. Sixteen documents were confirmed that way, including two multi-document bundles whose page ranges were mapped.

Where a candidate is recorded in the Nationwide inventory but the folder is not mounted in this container, identity is marked inferred_requires_one_byte_check and the recorded sha256 is carried so the attachment lane can verify in one step.
Nothing was fetched from any court host. Five targeted web lookups were used only to fix official identity and official URLs for documents established as absent.

classes.ATTACH_HELD_SOURCE: The artifact is held. The path, custody, sha256 and identity evidence are named so the attachment lane can bind it in one pass.
classes.ACQUIRE_EXACT_SOURCE: Genuinely not held. Exact official identity and issuing authority are established, with an exact official URL where one was fixed and an explicit urlKind and exactBinaryUrlEstablished flag where it was not.
classes.COMPOSE_FROM_AUTHORITY: No mandatory official fillable form exists. The authority prescribes the filing and the authority text is held. Left modelled as official_pdf_fill these families stay source-blocked forever.
classes.NON_PACKET_TREATMENT: The relief is not obtained by a participant-filed packet.
classes.EXACT_LEGAL_HOLD: One named legal-design question must be answered before any treatment is safe.

claimDiscipline: No packet-family claim was asserted or released. The claim ledger was not touched. No family was built, repaired or attached. No queue, verifier return or assignment file was written. No commercial route was opened and no family was promoted.
whatThisDoesNotEstablish: that any held file is the current official edition of the form
that a document marked inferred_requires_one_byte_check is the document named - that needs one read of the bytes
that any route may be built, promoted or sold

entries.fableA3Read: Read: the packs hold both a pre-adjudication and a post-adjudication drug-court pair, each naming its own adjudication posture on page 1. One label over two documents identifies neither.
entries.whyReclassified: ACIC publishes a pre-adjudication petition and order and a post-adjudication petition and order, four materially distinct documents. The two generic obligations each named one document and resolved to two, so neither candidate could stand in without deciding pre- versus post-adjudication by substitution. Each generic obligation is replaced by its two specifically named documents, and the route must answer pre- versus post-adjudication before source binding.

entries.why: RCW 13.50.260 relief is court-initiated. entries.why: The owner determined that all forms prescribed by Louisiana C.Cr.P. articles 987-995 and 998 use COMPOSE_FROM_AUTHORITY: article 986 makes the statutory articles themselves the prescribed forms, and the PDF renderings of 990 and 993 are reference renderings that create no separate source class. The treatment is therefore settled. What is not settled is the text: every Louisiana family depends on at least one of six articles whose codified text this repository holds ONLY in private/Nationwide Record Clearing, which is not carried by any release and is mounted nowhere.
entries.howAbsenceWasEstablished: FABLE-CA1 hashed all 845 files in both mounted corpora — the Master Library and the D source packs — against the six digests pinned in SOURCE_RELATIONSHIP_REGISTRY.json. Zero matches. The state pack carries names and citations only (blankPdfInSource false, sourceFileName null for all eleven); the compiled profile carries no form text; the legal review describes structure rather than the prescribed wording.
entries.theOneHumanAction: Mount private/Nationwide Record Clearing/LegalEase Louisiana/forms/, or publish the six articles' print views into the D source packs in the shape already proven for 990, 993, 995, 998 and 999.1. Their digests are pinned, so arrival is verifiable without trusting the courier.
entries.whatIsAlreadyEstablishedForABuilder: The $550 cap and the article 983(F) waiver, article 988's pre-filing sequencing, the 15-day district-attorney turnaround, the 60-day objection windows and the service list are all held in committed records and were recorded by CA1 so a later builder inherits them rather than re-deriving them.
alsoRaised: la-977d-marijuana-first-offense-set's only route is named after article 998, but 998 is absent from its own officialFormFamily — and 998's text IS held.
la-985-1-interim-expungement-set has no proposed-order component, though Track E is an article 994 motion plus an article 995 order, and 995 is held.
Article 983(M)'s $300 marijuana cap terminated 2026-08-01, which is already past. A packet stating $300 would state a repealed fee.

entries.why: The owner determined that the sworn statement, petition and order printed in Florida Rule of Criminal Procedure 3.989 are rule-prescribed forms taking COMPOSE_FROM_AUTHORITY, with the applicable held FDLE application attached as a separate official PDF component. The FDLE half is done. The rule half cannot be composed because Rule 3.989's text is recorded as an EMBEDDED_SECTION inside a bar-published rules PDF with artifactSha256 and heldPath both null — there is nothing to render from.
entries.theOneHumanAction: Acquire the current Rule 3.989 form text as an addressable artifact with a hash. One acquisition releases four families. The registry's own externally verified note already records that no separate fillable Rule 3.989 PDF exists, so this is an extraction from the rules publication rather than a search for a form.

fdleHalfAlreadyExecuted.fl-10yr-bridge-set: FDLE40-021-EXPUNCTION, same digest — the family carries exactly one routeKey, the court-ordered expunction under 943.0585, so it has no sealing leg; fl-sealing-set is its sealing counterpart

entries.whyTheSplitIsByRelief: A full text diff of the two 40-021 faces returns exactly two differing lines: a document UUID, and Request Type Seal versus Request Type Expunge. Identical footer, Revised October 2019, Ref. Rule 11C-7.006 and 11C-7.007. One form, two pre-filled editions — which is why the split is by requested relief and not by a new form number.
entries.establishedFromTheFormsOwnFace: The $75.00 nonrefundable FDLE fee is on the form itself. Under A3 that establishes the FDLE fee and nothing about any court filing fee.
entries.alsoRaised: fl-trafficking-set names Rule 3.9895, not 3.989. The determination reaches 3.989 only.

artifacts.officialTitle: Petition to Seal Arrest under Act 1460 of 2013; A.C.A. 16-90-1401, Et. Seq.

artifacts.identityEvidence: pdftotext -f 1 -l 1 -layout, read in this lane: page 1 prints the caption block "IN THE ______________ COURT OF ________________, ARKANSAS" over "____________ DIVISION", then the centred title "PETITION TO SEAL ARREST UNDER ACT 1460 OF 2013;" over "A.C.A.16-90-1401, Et. Seq.", then the operative line "Comes the Defendant and for his/her petition to seal the record states:". The face is a PETITION (participant-filed primary filing), it is scoped to an ARREST, and it is Act 1460. Page 1 footer prints "ACIC Form" / "Revised 08/25/2014".
artifacts.labelCaveat: The census names this document by a SHORTER label than the corpus form number -- census "ACIC-PETITION-TO-SEAL-ARREST" against corpus "AR-ACIC-PETITION-TO-SEAL-ARREST-UNDER-ACT-1460". That is an id-alias difference and not a missing document: the corpus index holds this exact path at this exact SHA-256, and the family's own source-receipt.json pins the same hash. The census word "UNIFORM" is printed on no ACIC document in the mounted corpus and is not relied on here; this binding rests on the title printed on page 1.
artifacts.whyTheLabelIsFamilySpecific: ACIC-PETITION-TO-SEAL-ARREST is named by exactly one family in data/rcap-grade-a/route-obligation-census-candidate/packet-family-build-worklist.json -- ar-arrest-seal-set -- measured in this lane. Scoping the finding to that family rather than binding the label globally cannot change what any family this lane does not hold resolves to, which is the whole reason the scope is used here.

reconcilerOrderingDefect.what: scripts/grade-a-route-obligation-census/reconcile-census-source-custody.mjs resolveFormLabel() returns null at `if (labelTokens.length < 3) return null;` before it ever consults identityFindings, so the read-identity tier is unreachable for any census label carrying fewer than three tokens of more than two characters.
reconcilerOrderingDefect.whyItMatters: The three-token floor is documented as a guard on tier 2's token-subset matcher — it exists to stop a two-token label like CR-65 matching almost anything. Tier 3 does not use tokens at all: it keys on the exact normalised label and then requires the corpus index to hold the finding's exact path at its exact SHA-256. The floor therefore constrains a tier that does not need it.
reconcilerOrderingDefect.costMeasuredInThisPass: 16 of the 21 identities confirmed here cannot bind while the ordering stands: all 11 New Mexico rule forms (4-222, 4-951, 4-952, 4-953, 4-955, 4-956, 4-959, 4-960, 4-960.1, 4-960.2, 4-960.3), Nebraska CC-6-12a, New Hampshire NHJB-3124-DS, and the two Kansas KSJC documents. Six families — nm_conviction-set, nm_identity_theft-set, nm_release_without_conviction-set, ne-seal-pardoned-set, ne-seal-pre2017-set and nh_marijuana_annulment-set — have every named source read and identified and would resolve completely.
reconcilerOrderingDefect.notChangedHere: The tier-3 admission rule was not weakened and this file was not edited. Moving the identityFindings lookup above the token floor would admit nothing that does not already satisfy all three conditions; that is an owner's call, not this lane's.

theOneDecisionThatCoversThisWholeCohort.question: May the source bytes the hosted acquisition runner has already fetched enter the repository, so the families blocked on them can be built?
theOneDecisionThatCoversThisWholeCohort.whyItIsOneDecisionAndNotTwenty: Every family below is blocked on the same fact and not on twenty different ones. The addresses are established, the fetches returned HTTP 200 with real documents, and every SHA-256 is recorded. The bytes sit in GitHub Actions artifacts, and artifact blobs are behind storage this container's proxy denies — so nothing here can read them, and nothing can be built from them.
theOneDecisionThatCoversThisWholeCohort.theContractThatReservesIt: The acquisition workflow says it in its own header: 'The bytes leave here as workflow artifacts. A human decides whether they enter the repository, after identity, currentness and intended use are confirmed. That decision is a reviewed commit, not a workflow run.' The standing instruction not to commit source bodies is what that contract enforces.
theOneDecisionThatCoversThisWholeCohort.whatIsAlreadyDone: Addresses established from committed evidence and document reads; queued; fetched; hashed; every receipt written back onto its manifest entry with the outcome, the content type, the byte length, the structural class and the runner's SHA-256.
theOneDecisionThatCoversThisWholeCohort.whatRemains: One authorization, then PROMO installs custody and the families build.
